blocks.text: Tabulation replaces demand-driven recursion with a planned traversal of states. To do that safely, the implementation must know which states exist, which values seed the computation, and which dependencies must precede each state. Overlap can motivate reuse but does not by itself provide those pieces. The same criterion applies whether the table is one-dimensional or multidimensional.
